about: The owner's second grading batch. Grade a whole line or part of one (a span), good or bad, with a strength (0.5 for half); spoken notes are read by scripts/dialogue-batch/spoken-grades.ts. Each grade lands on the grade map (src/english/grade-map.ts) and moves every line sharing the graded part's features in the same kind of scene or the same register and voice. Chosen by scripts/dialogue-batch/batch-two.ts.
